{{Quote|You can come quietly, or die quickly!|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to the courier before killing him|<ref name="Rebel Escape">{{JournalCite|7|Rebel Escape}}</ref>}}
This '''unidentified [[Courier/Legends|courier]]''' worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. While on an important [[Mari's mission|mission]] with his close friend [[Mari (Courier)|Mari]], he was gunned down in a [[Unidentified cantina (Mari and Boba Fett)|cantina]] by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was out to collect a bounty that the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] had issued on the two couriers. Eventually, Mari completed their mission with the help of a motley group of spacers.

==Behind the scenes==
Although as of yet unnamed, this character is a significant plot device in the [[Rebel Escape|role playing game scenario]] in which he appears, as it is his killing that initiates the entire scenario.
